slides.slide_title: Rethink Transformer:级联专家视角
slides.slide_claim: 把 Transformer 每个 block 视为专家,所有 token 经同一组专家串行处理
slide_key_text: All tokens are processed by the same experts
Input tokens: All cats love fish but hate to get their paws wet

slides.slide_title: 新范式:混合专家 MoE

slides.slide_title: 新范式:混合深度 MoD

Different tokens are processed by the different experts

slides.slide_title: 稀疏新基座模型:训练到推理

slides.slide_title: 稀疏新基座模型:面向未来
slides.slide_claim: 稀疏栈继续演进,硬件由 GPU 迈向专用 Sp-X PU

N:M sparsity can achieve accuracy-hardware efficiency trade-off[3]

slides.slide_title: 挑战:训练推理统一的稀疏架构缺失

Sparse training consists of three stages (operators)

slides.slide_title: TB-STC 稀疏 Pattern:可转置块级 N:M
slides.slide_claim: 可转置块级 N:M 同时探索块级与维度级稀疏灵活性

slide_visual_skeleton: 稀疏 pattern 示意占位框

slides.slide_title: Tech.2:SpMM 与 SDDMM 算子
slides.slide_claim: 可配置输入选择+输出交替实现数据通路共享,面效率提 2.60×

TB-STC improves the area efficiency by 2.60×

slides.slide_claim: 基于 partial softmax 的 Attention 引入额外更新开销

Is it feasible to use a unified maximum for all blocks

slide_key_text: A unified maximum for partial softmax operation and a recomputation mechanism to ensure accuracy
The unified maximum preserves the mathematical equivalence of softmax

slide_key_text: Use fine-grained tiling to improve parallelism with small N and double buffering with large N
Improve parallelism with small N / Fine-grained Tiling / GPU utilization
Alleviate memory bottleneck with large N / Double buffering / Overlap computation and data movement

slide_key_text: For a given linear workload, it is non-trivial to find the optimal underlying implementation
Sub-optimal implementation brings significant performance loss

Shape [4,4096,4096]: FastGEMV is 50% slower than Flat GEMM

Build the table to map the optimal impl
Up to 1.29x speedup over the static implementation
